27 interface core_v_xif
28 #(
29   parameter int unsigned X_NUM_RS               = 2,  // Number of register file read ports that can be used by the eXtension interface
30   parameter int unsigned X_ID_WIDTH             = 4,  // Width of ID field.
31   parameter int unsigned X_RFR_WIDTH            = 32, // Register file read access width for the eXtension interface
32   parameter int unsigned X_RFW_WIDTH            = 32, // Register file write access width for the eXtension interface
33   parameter int unsigned X_NUM_HARTS            = 1,  // Number of harts (hardware threads) associated with the interface
34   parameter int unsigned X_HARTID_WIDTH         = 1,  // Width of ``hartid`` signals.
35   parameter logic [31:0] X_MISA                 = '0, // MISA extensions implemented on the eXtension interface
36   parameter logic [ 1:0] X_ECS_XS               = '0, // Initial value for mstatus.XS
37   parameter int unsigned X_DUALREAD             = 0,  // Is dual read supported? 0: No, 1: Yes, for ``rs1``, 2: Yes, for ``rs1`` - ``rs2``, 3: Yes, for ``rs1`` - ``rs3``
38   parameter int unsigned X_DUALWRITE            = 0,  // Is dual write supported? 0: No, 1: Yes.
39   parameter int unsigned X_ISSUE_REGISTER_SPLIT = 0,  // Does the interface pipeline register interface? 0: No, 1: Yes.
40   parameter int unsigned X_MEM_WIDTH            = 32  // Memory access width for loads/stores via the eXtension interface
41 );
42 
43   typedef logic [X_NUM_RS+X_DUALREAD-1:0] readregflags_t;
44   typedef logic [X_DUALWRITE:0] writeregflags_t;
45   typedef logic [X_NUM_RS-1:0][X_RFR_WIDTH-1:0] mode_t;
46   typedef logic [X_ID_WIDTH-1:0] id_t;
47   typedef logic [X_HARTID_WIDTH-1:0] hartid_t;
48 
49   typedef struct packed {
50     logic [15:0] instr;  // Offloaded compressed instruction
51     hartid_t hartid;  // Identification of the hart offloading the instruction
52   } x_compressed_req_t;
53 
54   typedef struct packed {
55     logic [31:0] instr;  // Uncompressed instruction
56     logic accept;  // Is the offloaded compressed instruction (id) accepted by the coprocessor?
57   } x_compressed_resp_t;
58 
59   typedef struct packed {
60     logic [31:0] instr;  // Offloaded instruction
61     mode_t mode;  // Effective Privilege level, as used for load and store instructions.
62     hartid_t hartid;  // Identification of the hart offloading the instruction
63     id_t id;  // Identification of the offloaded instruction
64   } x_issue_req_t;
65 
66   typedef struct packed {
67     logic accept;  // Is the offloaded instruction (id) accepted by the coprocessor?
68     writeregflags_t writeback;  // Will the coprocessor perform a writeback in the core to rd?
69     readregflags_t register_read;   // Will the coprocessor perform require specific registers to be read?
70     logic ecswrite;  // Will the coprocessor perform a writeback in the core to mstatus.xs, mstatus.fs, mstatus.vs
71     logic loadstore;  // Is the offloaded instruction a load/store instruction?
72   } x_issue_resp_t;
73 
74   typedef struct packed {
75     hartid_t hartid;  // Identification of the hart offloading the instruction
76     id_t id;  // Identification of the offloaded instruction
77     /* verilator lint_off UNPACKED */
78     logic [X_RFR_WIDTH-1:0] rs[X_NUM_RS-1:0];  // Register file source operands for the offloaded instruction.
79     readregflags_t rs_valid; // Validity of the register file source operand(s).
80     logic [5:0] ecs; // Extension Context Status ({mstatus.xs, mstatus.fs, mstatus.vs})
81     logic ecs_valid; // Validity of the Extension Context Status.
82   } x_register_t;
83 
84   typedef struct packed {
85     hartid_t hartid;  // Identification of the hart offloading the instruction
86     id_t id;  // Identification of the offloaded instruction
87     logic commit_kill;  // Shall an offloaded instruction be killed?
88   } x_commit_t;
89 
90   typedef struct packed {
91     hartid_t hartid;  // Identification of the hart offloading the instruction
92     id_t id;  // Identification of the offloaded instruction
93     logic [31:0] addr;  // Virtual address of the memory transaction
94     mode_t mode;  // Privilege level
95     logic we;  // Write enable of the memory transaction
96     logic [2:0] size;  // Size of the memory transaction
97     logic [X_MEM_WIDTH/8-1:0] be;  // Byte enables for memory transaction
98     logic [1:0] attr;  // Memory transaction attributes
99     logic [X_MEM_WIDTH  -1:0] wdata;  // Write data of a store memory transaction
100     logic last;  // Is this the last memory transaction for the offloaded instruction?
101     logic spec;  // Is the memory transaction speculative?
102   } x_mem_req_t;
103 
104   typedef struct packed {
105     logic exc;  // Did the memory request cause a synchronous exception?
106     logic [5:0] exccode;  // Exception code
107     logic dbg;  // Did the memory request cause a debug trigger match with ``mcontrol.timing`` = 0?
108   } x_mem_resp_t;
109 
110   typedef struct packed {
111     hartid_t hartid;  // Identification of the hart offloading the instruction
112     id_t id;  // Identification of the offloaded instruction
113     logic [X_MEM_WIDTH-1:0] rdata;  // Read data of a read memory transaction
114     logic err;  // Did the instruction cause a bus error?
115     logic dbg;  // Did the read data cause a debug trigger match with ``mcontrol.timing`` = 0?
116   } x_mem_result_t;
117 
118   typedef struct packed {
119     hartid_t hartid;  // Identification of the hart offloading the instruction
120     id_t id;  // Identification of the offloaded instruction
121     logic [X_RFW_WIDTH     -1:0] data;  // Register file write data value(s)
122     logic [4:0] rd;  // Register file destination address(es)
123     writeregflags_t we;  // Register file write enable(s)
124     logic [2:0] ecswe;  // Write enables for {mstatus.xs, mstatus.fs, mstatus.vs}
125     logic [5:0] ecsdata;  // Write data value for {mstatus.xs, mstatus.fs, mstatus.vs}
126     logic exc;  // Did the instruction cause a synchronous exception?
127     logic [5:0] exccode;  // Exception code
128     logic dbg;  // Did the instruction cause a debug trigger match with ``mcontrol.timing`` = 0?
129     logic err;  // Did the instruction cause a bus error?

110   typedef struct packed {
111     hartid_t hartid;  // Identification of the hart offloading the instruction
112     id_t id;  // Identification of the offloaded instruction
113     logic [X_MEM_WIDTH-1:0] rdata;  // Read data of a read memory transaction
114     logic err;  // Did the instruction cause a bus error?
115     logic dbg;  // Did the read data cause a debug trigger match with ``mcontrol.timing`` = 0?
116   } x_mem_result_t;
117 
118   typedef struct packed {
119     hartid_t hartid;  // Identification of the hart offloading the instruction
120     id_t id;  // Identification of the offloaded instruction
121     logic [X_RFW_WIDTH     -1:0] data;  // Register file write data value(s)
122     logic [4:0] rd;  // Register file destination address(es)
123     writeregflags_t we;  // Register file write enable(s)
124     logic [2:0] ecswe;  // Write enables for {mstatus.xs, mstatus.fs, mstatus.vs}
125     logic [5:0] ecsdata;  // Write data value for {mstatus.xs, mstatus.fs, mstatus.vs}
126     logic exc;  // Did the instruction cause a synchronous exception?
127     logic [5:0] exccode;  // Exception code
128     logic dbg;  // Did the instruction cause a debug trigger match with ``mcontrol.timing`` = 0?
129     logic err;  // Did the instruction cause a bus error?
130   } x_result_t;
131 
132   // Compressed interface
133   logic               compressed_valid;
134   logic               compressed_ready;
135   x_compressed_req_t  compressed_req;
136   x_compressed_resp_t compressed_resp;
137 
138   // Issue interface
139   logic               issue_valid;
140   logic               issue_ready;
141   x_issue_req_t       issue_req;
142   x_issue_resp_t      issue_resp;
143 
144   // Register interface
145   logic               register_valid;
146   logic               register_ready;
147   x_register_t        register;
148 
149   // Commit interface
150   logic               commit_valid;
151   x_commit_t          commit;
152 
153   // Memory (request/response) interface
154   logic               mem_valid;
155   logic               mem_ready;
156   x_mem_req_t         mem_req;
157   x_mem_resp_t        mem_resp;
158 
159   // Memory result interface
160   logic               mem_result_valid;
161   x_mem_result_t      mem_result;
162 
163   // Result interface
164   logic               result_valid;
165   logic               result_ready;
166   x_result_t          result;
167 
168   // Port directions for host CPU
169   modport core_v_xif_cpu_compressed (
170     output compressed_valid,
171     input  compressed_ready,
172     output compressed_req,
173     input  compressed_resp
174   );
175 
176   modport core_v_xif_cpu_issue (
177     output issue_valid,
178     input  issue_ready,
179     output issue_req,
180     input  issue_resp
181   );
182 
183   modport core_v_xif_cpu_register (
184     output register_valid,
185     input  register_ready,
186     output register
187   );
188 
189   modport core_v_xif_cpu_commit (
190     output commit_valid,
191     output commit
192   );
193 
194   modport core_v_xif_cpu_mem (
195     input  mem_valid,
196     output mem_ready,
197     input  mem_req,
198     output mem_resp
199   );
200 
201   modport core_v_xif_cpu_mem_result (
202     output mem_result_valid,
203     output mem_result
204   );
205 
206   modport core_v_xif_cpu_result (
207     input  result_valid,
208     output result_ready,
209     input  result
210   );
211 
212   // Port directions for CO-PROCESSOR
213   modport core_v_xif_coprocessor_compressed (
214     input   compressed_valid,
215     output  compressed_ready,
216     input   compressed_req,
217     output  compressed_resp
218   );
219 
220   modport core_v_xif_coprocessor_issue (
221     input   issue_valid,
222     output  issue_ready,
223     input   issue_req,
224     output  issue_resp
225   );
226 
227   modport core_v_xif_coprocessor_register (
228     input   register_valid,
229     output  register_ready,
230     input   register
231   );
232 
233   modport core_v_xif_coprocessor_commit (
234     input   commit_valid,
235     input   commit
236   );
237 
238   modport core_v_xif_coprocessor_mem (
239     output  mem_valid,
240     input   mem_ready,
241     output  mem_req,
242     input   mem_resp
243   );
244 
245   modport core_v_xif_coprocessor_mem_result (
246     input   mem_result_valid,
247     input   mem_result
248   );
249 
250   modport core_v_xif_coprocessor_result (
251     output  result_valid,
252     input   result_ready,
253     output  result
254   );
255 
256 
257 endinterface : core_v_xif
